semantics.definition: One centered vertical axis physically and compositionally connects distinct lower, middle, and upper realms through readable boundary crossings. A giant tree, tower, or mountain that merely occupies the background without realm-specific transitions is not sufficient.
paraphrase_examples: 하나의 중심축이 지하·지상·천상 세 영역을 관통하며 각 경계에서 물질과 방향이 바뀐다
a single centered world axis crosses lower middle and upper realms with traceable passage through both boundaries

any_terms: one dominant centered vertical structure serves as the world axis
lower middle and upper realms remain visually distinct around the same axis
the axis visibly penetrates the boundary between lower and middle realms
the axis visibly penetrates the boundary between middle and upper realms
one uninterrupted route or energy flow connects all three realms along the axis

contrast_examples: a tall tower in one landscape

semantics.definition: Three distinct Moirai perform complementary actions on one continuous mortal life thread: Clotho spins its origin, Lachesis measures its allotted length, and Atropos cuts its endpoint. Three women with yarn or a severed thread without role continuity does not express the allocation of a life.
paraphrase_examples: 클로토가 뽑고 라케시스가 재며 아트로포스가 자르는 하나의 생명실이 세 역할을 연속적으로 연결한다
three fate figures occupy distinct spin measure and cut stations along one uninterrupted human life thread

any_terms: three distinct fate figures occupy separate readable work roles
the first figure visibly spins or draws the beginning of the thread
the second figure visibly measures an allotted section of that same thread
the third figure visibly cuts the endpoint of that same thread
one continuous mortal life thread physically connects the spin measure and cut roles

contrast_examples: a broken thread with no measurement role

semantics.definition: A demonstrably living traveler crosses a one-way downward threshold from the human world into a distinct underworld while carrying a visible objective, guide token, or retrieval purpose. Cave exploration, burial of a corpse, a dead soul being escorted, or directionless dark travel does not establish katabasis.
paraphrase_examples: 살아 있음을 보여 주는 여행자가 지상 경계를 뒤로하고 목적물을 든 채 저승의 문 아래로 내려간다
one living hero moves from daylight through a guarded downward gate toward an underworld objective

any_terms: one traveler shows breath warm color active grip or another explicit sign of living agency
daylight vegetation settlement or another human-world cue remains behind the traveler
stairs slope gate or river crossing establishes a directional descent across a boundary
a distinct chthonic realm lies below or beyond the crossed threshold
a named objective guide token retrieval object or mission cue travels with the living visitor

contrast_examples: a dead soul escorted by a psychopomp
a dark road with no underworld boundary

semantics.definition: An ancient Egyptian judgment scene shows the deceased before a two-pan balance where a heart is weighed against the feather of Ma'at, Anubis attends the weighing, Thoth records the result, and Ammit or Osiris establishes the consequence. Generic scales, Anubis alone, or mixed-pantheon judgment imagery is not equivalent.
paraphrase_examples: 죽은 이 앞의 양팔 저울 한쪽에는 심장, 다른 쪽에는 마아트의 깃털이 있고 아누비스가 저울을 다루며 토트가 결과를 적는다
the deceased faces a heart-versus-feather balance attended by Anubis while Thoth records and judgment awaits

any_terms: one deceased person stands or kneels as the explicit subject of judgment
one two-pan balance holds a human heart opposite the feather of Ma'at
Anubis visibly adjusts attends or verifies the central balance
Thoth visibly writes or records the weighing result beside the scale
Ammit waits near the balance or Osiris receives the outcome as a visible consequence

contrast_examples: a heart and feather used as decoration
Greek and Egyptian judges mixed together
